text:
jamie: Heads-up — after the cust-hydra LoRA merge into main-stable we see invoice formatting regressions in the quick eval pack. cc @mira @sandeep :eyes:

jamie: Quick numbers: invoice_amount_exact_match fell 0.92 -> 0.85, MAE up by ~0.12. Regression amplifies under quantization (int4 worse).

mira: Ack. Is this breaking reproduction for both fp16 and int4 or only quantized variants?

jamie: Repro on both. fp16 ~ -3% exact match, int4 ~ -8.5%.

sandeep: Paste the eval command you used so I can run locally.

jamie: Command I ran on staging laptop:
```
./eval_pack/run.sh --model models/cust-hydra-lora:merge-2026-03-20 \
  --quant int4 --evals ./packs/invoice_quick.json --out /tmp/hydra_q
```

luca: Noted. Last month we saw a tokenizer-boundary issue with another adapter — dollar sign + numbers sometimes tokenized differently which affected numeric formatting.

jamie: Example failures pulled from /tmp/hydra_q/failures.json:
- prompt: `Invoice: $1234.56`
- expected: `Invoice: $1,234.56`
- actual (fp16): `Invoice:$ 1234.56`  <-- missing space before $
- actual (int4): `Invoice: $1234 .56`  <-- stray space before decimal

eva: I launched a dedicated staging run and captured logs. There's a KV-cache alignment warning right before the invoice tests start.
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:05Z] kvcache: warn - key_offset mismatch (expected 128, got 120)
[2026-03-20T14:12:05Z] tokenizer: info - subtoken merge map applied
[2026-03-20T14:12:06Z] eval: start invoice_quick (len=23)
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued — canary for `merge-2026-03-20` -> staging in 5m :rocket:

mira: I reproduced locally with jamie's command. Holding the staging canary. Trying a quick patch that forces adapter->tokenizer coupling (adapter-swap) and re-running the pack.

sandeep: If the patch doesn't land quickly, enable fallback routing for that customer to `redwood/llama-2.1-base` variant. We can't ship malformed invoices.

jamie: Agree. I'm going to run a pinned fp16 canary with strict-tokenizer mapping for cust-hydra and will attach failure artifacts in ~20m.

luca: Also recommend adding a minimal edgecase pack for currency/decimal/grouping to our smoke evals: `packs/invoice_edgecases.json`. Should catch this earlier.

jamie: Added `packs/invoice_edgecases.json` and re-ran both packs: `--evals ./packs/invoice_quick.json,./packs/invoice_edgecases.json`. Posting initial diffs shortly.

mira: Thanks. Keep the canary gated. If anyone finds a reproducible seed/tensor, drop it here and I'll add a unit test to the PR. :thumbsup:

jamie: Will upload failing sample set `/tmp/hydra_q/failures.json` and link in PR. Also saving eval metrics snapshot to `/tmp/hydra_q/metrics_snapshot.json` for bisecting.

eva: FYI the warning suggests KV-cache key_offset drift which could cause earlier token positions to shift, explaining the misplaced spaces. Could be adapter merge changed attention/key sizing assumptions.

sandeep: Good catch. If adapter merges changed kv cache stride we need a small compatibility shim in runtime that checks adapter metadata vs model runtime key_stride and applies a no-op padding when mismatched.

luca: If we add shim, include a cheap unit test: run a 2-step generation with known token positions and assert tokens for `$` and `.` remain aligned.

mira: I'll hold off merging any performance patches until we confirm shim correctness across int4 and fp16.

jamie: Next steps: (1) gate canary (done), (2) reproduce and collect failing examples (done), (3) test adapter-tokenizer swap patch (in prog), (4) if patch fails, enable customer fallback routing. I'll open the PR with logs + failures in ~30m.

luca: Thanks — looping in SRE if we need a hot rollback on prod traffic.

jamie: tagging the PR w/ `regress:invoice-format` when ready.
